subtasks.title: Implement and export slugify
subtasks.goal:
Add the ASCII slug utility using named ESM exports.
New src/slug.mjs → export function slugify(text), returning text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').
src/index.mjs → retain export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
No existing code is removed; do not modify tests or package configuration.
